title: ProgramAccessViewDocument
description: Server-maintained, rules-readable summary of one account's current authority over one program: the programme owner as manager, or a staff member's active duties with the owner-approval proof and every expiry already folded in, and whether the account manages the programme's organizer. Security rules read it with one get() to authorize direct reads of programme read models; the phone shows it as work access and gates the programme list and detail on it offline. Written by triggers on programStaffGrants, organizerPrograms and organizers. Holds ids, duty names and expiry instants only: no name, phone number or free text. Never the grant's identity fields and never mutation authority; commands re-check authority from the source documents.

uid.description: The account the view describes; the document id is programId__uid.

ownerUid.description: The programme's immutable creator; read models carry it so rules can recognise the owner without a lookup.

role.description: manager is the programme owner and holds every duty; staff hold the duties below.

status.description: inactive when the grant is revoked, unapproved by the owner, expired or malformed, and for an organizer manager who holds no live duty. Rules deny an inactive view; the phone treats it as no duty access.

activeFromMillis.description: The owner approval instant; authority is not live before it. 0 for the owner and legacy creator-issued grants.

expiresAtMillis.description: Exclusive end of the last live duty, bounded by the grant expiry and the owner's authorization deadline. Null for the owner.

duties.description: Duty name to the latest exclusive expiry at which the duty is held in some scope, with the coordinator duty counted for every duty but programAdmin.

pickupAll.description: Duty name to the latest expiry of an assignment that covers every pickup point.

pickupScoped.description: Key duty__pickupPointId to the latest expiry of an assignment that names that pickup point.

hotelAll.description: Duty name to the latest expiry of an assignment that covers every hotel.

hotelScoped.description: Key duty__hotelId to the latest expiry of an assignment that names that hotel.

functionAll.description: Duty name to the latest expiry of an assignment that covers every function.

functionScoped.description: Key duty__functionId to the latest expiry of an assignment that names that function.

programAll.description: Duty name to the latest expiry of one assignment that covers every pickup point, hotel and function at once, with the coordinator duty counted for every duty but programAdmin. pickupAll, hotelAll and functionAll cannot say this, because each can be raised by a different assignment. The guest directory rules read guestRelations here, as requireProgramGuestDirectoryAccess admits a whole-programme guest relations duty only. Views written before this field read as holding none.

workPickup.description: The pickup points the work shell lists for this account, as the work-access callable resolves them: key "*" when some live operational duty covers every one, otherwise one key per named id; each value is the latest exclusive expiry of a duty reaching it. Hotel desk duties reach hotels only; programAdmin reaches none; functions come from door and guest-desk duties.

workHotel.description: The hotels the work shell lists for this account, as the work-access callable resolves them: key "*" when some live operational duty covers every one, otherwise one key per named id; each value is the latest exclusive expiry of a duty reaching it. Hotel desk duties reach hotels only; programAdmin reaches none; functions come from door and guest-desk duties.

workFunction.description: The functions the work shell lists for this account, as the work-access callable resolves them: key "*" when some live operational duty covers every one, otherwise one key per named id; each value is the latest exclusive expiry of a duty reaching it. Hotel desk duties reach hotels only; programAdmin reaches none; functions come from door and guest-desk duties.

arrivalRoutes.description: The arrivals journeys the account's airport greeter, transport dispatcher and coordinator assignments reach, as the arrivals roster resolves them: key pickup|hotel, where either side is an id or * for every one, so one assignment's pickup and hotel scopes cover a journey together; the value is the latest exclusive expiry of an assignment reaching it. A journey with no pickup point or hotel is ~ on that side, which only * reaches. An assignment whose scopes would expand past 300 routes grants none.

tripRoutes.description: The transport trips the account's reconciliation viewer, transport dispatcher and coordinator assignments reach, as the retired listProgramTrips callable resolved them: key pickup|hotel with the same meaning as arrivalRoutes (an id or * on each side; a trip with no hotel is ~ on that side, which only * reaches). Capped at 300 routes per assignment, failing closed.

assignments.description: The staff member's live duty assignments with their resource scopes and own expiries, as getProgramWorkAccess returns them in duties; empty for the owner and for an inactive view. Phones need the tuples because a transport route needs one assignment to cover both ends, which the flattened maps cannot say.

grantExpiresAtMillis.description: The grant's own expiry, as getProgramWorkAccess returns it; null for the owner and for an inactive view.

organizerManager.description: True while the account manages the programme's organizer (its hostUserId, ownerUserId or hostUserIds, as requireProgramSetupAccess reads them): setup authority over the programme's list row and detail, independent of status and the expiries, and never a duty or guest access by itself. An organizer manager who neither created the programme nor holds a live grant gets a view with status inactive, role staff, empty maps and this flag; a manager who stops managing loses the flag, and the view when nothing else holds it. Views written before the flag read as false.

revision.description: The source grant's revision; 0 for the owner. Phones compare it to see authority narrow or widen.
